# THE HEADLINE FINDING: A FONT THE DOCUMENT FETCHES IS NOT A FONT THE CANVAS HAS.
#   The five slot HUD rows have been PARTIAL since wave 46 for one reason each: the readout
#   faces were built (b1f51430) and the six families were not fetched. index.html was then
#   changed to link all six — Bitcount Grid Double, Bitcount Single, Chango, Mouse Memoirs,
#   Sancreek, Cherry Bomb One — and the brief asked this lane to re-measure the rows against
#   that. Re-measured, the residual DID NOT CLOSE, and the reason is the half nobody had
#   looked at: a linked Google Fonts stylesheet DECLARES an @font-face; the browser fetches
#   the file when a RENDERED ELEMENT asks for the family. The slot engine's text is not an
#   element. Phaser measures and fills it on a 2D canvas context, and a canvas pulls no
#   webfont. So every bar still resolved the stack's next entry (DM Mono, else Courier New)
#   on a cold load, and "the font is fetched" was true of the stylesheet and false of the font.
#   The old standalone Starbound build knew this — cosmic-slots-phaser/src/scenes/Preloader.ts
#   injects @font-face and pre-loads through the FontFace API — and the engine that replaced
#   it did not carry the knowledge across. slots/engine/fonts.ts now asks document.fonts for
#   the four kind-stack families plus the running skin's own face, in the same Promise.all as
#   the engine's dynamic imports, raced against a 1200ms deadline. It goes BEFORE the game is
#   constructed because a Phaser Text renders once and keeps its bitmap: a face that lands
#   after a readout is drawn never reaches the player. Nothing blocks on it; a face that
#   misses the window falls through the CSS stack, which is what the stack is for.
